title: Subset Parade
statement_md: Every possible squad must march in the parade. Given $n$ distinct fighters $a_0, \dots, a_{n-1}$, list every subset in increasing **bitmask order**: subset number $m$ (from $0$ to $2^n - 1$) contains $a_i$ exactly when bit $i$ of $m$ is set.
input_md: The first line holds $n$. The second line holds $n$ distinct integers.
output_md: Print $2^n$ lines. Line $m+1$ lists the members of subset $m$ in index order, separated by spaces. Print `-` for the empty subset.
hints: Loop m from 0 to 2^n - 1; element i belongs to subset m when (m >> i) & 1 is 1.

reference_solution:
import sys


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    a = data[1:1 + n]
    out = []
    for m in range(1 << n):
        part = [a[i] for i in range(n) if m >> i & 1]
        out.append(" ".join(part) if part else "-")
    print("\n".join(out))


main()
